ValidationRule.description: Winning Competitor can only be entered when Opportunity Stage = "Dead" or "Lost"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Winning_Competitor__c,'Yes'), ISPICKVAL(Winning_Competitor__c,'No') ), IF( NOT(OR( ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName ,'Lost'), ISPICKVAL(Opportunity__r.StageName ,'Dead') )), TRUE, FALSE ), FALSE )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Winning Competitor can only be entered when Opportunity Stage is "Lost"
